A breathtaking '''palace''' was [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] residence in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was protected by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] and security droids.
